title: Cyclops Tool Definitions
description: Canonical set of browser tools the extension can execute. The backend uses this list to validate model-generated action plans.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click a visible element on the page.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Fill a form input with a value. Sensitive values must use local_profile references.

tools.name: upload
tools.description: Upload a local file through a file input. File contents stay local; use local_profile references.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page or a scrollable element.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate the browser tab to a URL.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot for local vision processing by the extension. The backend never receives or processes the raw screenshot.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait for a specified duration before the next action.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Simulate pressing a keyboard key or key combination.

tools.name: select
tools.description: Select an option from a <select> dropdown element.
